entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Looks like we made a great[n]miscalculation, Inmate!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Contrary to our assumptions, it seems you[n]have turned out to be quite promising.
entries.uk: Усупереч нашим припущенням, ти, схоже,[n]виявився доволі перспективним.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Your powers continue to grow, as do[n]the relationships you hold with your[n]contractors.
entries.uk: Ваші сили зростають, як і зв'язки[n]з тими, з ким ви уклали угоди.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: It seems the rehabilitation is proceeding[n]at a fine rate.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You are quite the cautious one.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Allow me to warn you on one matter.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Being at the peak may mean you are[n]mere moments from your downfall.
entries.uk: Бути на вершині — це, можливо,[n]бути за мить від падіння.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Unexpected situations are necessary[n]in a "game," after all.
